high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot of a presentation slide during a conference or seminar. The slide is titled "On the Measure of Intelligence" by François Chollet from Google, Inc., dated November 5, 2019. The abstract section of the slide discusses the need for defining and evaluating intelligence in a way that allows comparisons between artificial systems and humans. It mentions the abundance of attempts over the past hundred years to define and measure intelligence across psychology and AI fields.
